name: Innocent Facade
body:
Innocent Facade (Sp)
Source Magic Tactics Toolbox pg. 27
Once per day, a rogue with this talent can use innocenceAPG as a spell-like ability, using her rogue level as the spell’s caster level. A rogue must have the minor magic talent before selecting this talent. An investigator can select the innocent facade rogue talent in place of an investigator talent. She must have the underworld inspirationACG investigator talent before selecting this talent, instead of minor magic.
